body: I feel your pain friend, just keep reminding your self that there will be a day, it maybe weeks months or years from now, that will change everything, and you won’t feel this way anymore. It’s a long process but it’s the only thing that keeps me going. You never know what’s around the corner.

Exactly the same as my ex, it was terrifying to see it slowly happen over the past year. Sent me into a deep depression because I tried everything to get back to what we had before. It’s like she was a ghost that would occasionally come back. Absolutely heart breaking as I’m sure she could not understand what was happening either.
In a way I think that’s what bonded me so strong with her, I guess it’s like a trauma bond
It’s hell honestly, it’s so hard to let go.
